text:
anna: heads up, deploybot failed to promote staging -> eu cluster in the 10:00-11:00 window. EU mirror image missing provenance annotation.
ben: ok which image? tag or digest?
anna: tag=release-1.42.0-eu, digest=sha256:3a7f5d2e9c4b...c9b
deploybot: Promotion blocked: missing annotation cosign.sigstore.dev/provenance for release-1.42.0-eu (sha256:3a7f5d2e9c4b...c9b) in eu-west-1. See https://deploy.internal/release/1716234567 :warning:
olga: looks like last-night backfill finished multipart upload before attestation webhook responded.
sam: can we re-run attestation-only, or do we need to retag+push?
ben: attestation-only should work if manifest is still present. Try aws ecr batch-get-image with imageDigest=sha256:3a7f5d2e9c4b...c9b in eu-west-1.
anna: ran batch-get-image, manifest returned, but deploybot still rejects because manifest lacks the cosign annotation key.
olga: kicking attestation job attest-job/1716234720 now.
olga: attest-job started (ETA ~90s).
deploybot: attest-job/1716234720 succeeded and added cosign.sigstore.dev/provenance to sha256:3a7f5d2e9c4b...c9b.
sam: nice. please re-run the promote.
anna: /deploy promote release-1.42.0-eu --to=eu-cluster --canary=10%
deploybot: Promotion queued. Pre-checks OK. Starting canary rollout.
ben: holding 10% canary for 30m, watching p50/p95 and 5xxs. rollback criteria: >15% increase in p95 or >2x 5xx rate vs baseline.
anna: adding release notes line: "EU mirror attestation backfilled; no customer-facing changes." also note the change-window glitch.
olga: follow-up action: add guard to mirror backfill to wait for attestation webhook completion or retry on missing annotation. Filed ARCH-451 (assignee: olga).
sam: also add metric mirror.missing_attestation.count and alert if >3 in 1h.
anna: closing - canary healthy so far. ping if anyone sees anomalies. :thumbsup:
